$comment: THE API CONTRACT. One list of field names per DTO, read by tests on BOTH
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. frontend/app/types/index.ts is a hand-maintained
mirror of these records - there is no OpenAPI generation and no shared
package. Before this file, renaming a field in EventDTO broke the frontend
and nothing failed: the backend suite passed, the frontend suite passed,
and the defect surfaced in a browser. Neither side could catch it alone,
because neither side knows the other's types.
HOW TO CHANGE THE API. Edit this file in the SAME commit as the code. Both
tests will fail until both sides match it, which is the point - the failure
names the field and the side that has not caught up yet.
Names are the JSON keys on the wire, so they are what the frontend sees.
Order does not matter; both tests sort before comparing.
